Hello, Teacher! I really admire your painting style, which is why I’m writing this commission request.
The character I need you to draw is a genderless figure, who is a deity overseeing the balance of Yin and Yang. You can incorporate elements such as Taiji (Yin-Yang symbol), paper streamers, black and white lotus flowers, and magatama (curved jewels). More detailed references can be found in the character design book.
Please pay attention to the following details: The skin tone should be colorless, either white or pale gray, and the tongue should be black. The white hair should be slightly longer than the black hair, so please show that difference. The character usually has a cold and aloof expression.
Thank you for taking the time to read this, and I look forward to your reply.
